(features/plan/types.ts); repository.ts persists both on create (createLessonTaskRow, createLessonTasksFanOut/buildSharedInsertValues) and update (updateLessonTaskRow); mapLessonTaskRow.ts maps them back. Validation: new validateScheduleTimeWindow() in features/plan/server/validation.ts enforces paired-or-neither and end>start; wired into both features/plan/api/routes/lesson.ts (PUT, the route the form actually uses) and features/plan/api/routes/lessons.ts (POST, for symmetry with create-time input). features/schedule/server/service.ts buildDailySchedule: a lesson with BOTH scheduledStartTime and scheduledEndTime set is placed at those exact times, marked flexibilityState:'locked' (reusing the existing reflow special-case), and the cursor advances to max(cursor, overrideEnd + transitionMinutes) so later unset lessons don't overlap; a lesson with only one of the two fields set falls through to the unchanged synthesized path (partial overrides are never honored, per the paired-or-neither rule — validated at the API boundary, and defensively true in the scheduler too). LessonTaskForm.tsx gained optional 'Start time'/'End time' <input type=time> fields with inline validation (paired-or-neither, end<=start) mirroring the existing titleError pattern; clearing both submits undefined for both. npm run build: type-check ('Linting and checking validity of types...') completed with no errors; build then failed at static generation of /(shell)/about — this is the same known, pre-existing, unrelated Next.js build-worker DB-path issue documented across every phase of the prior G1-G7 batch, not caused by this phase's changes.
